description.value:
Creeps and Curses V.3.1

Special Grade Boon. When players reach level 20, they are generally expected to be capable enough to battle Special Grades. A GM can choose to give these players Special Grade Boons as rewards and power-ups to help in the battle against those nasty curses.

You have mastered your Cursed Energy Trait. Creatures suffer the penalty of your Cursed Trait Mastery even if they succeed a save against your raw cursed energy.

Rough. You gain a +3 bonus to your attack rolls and a bonus to damage rolls using raw cursed energy equal to your CE score(such as cursed strike). This replaces the bonus to attack and damage rolls of your Mastered Trait.

Smooth. You reduce bludgeoning, slashing, and piercing damage taken by your CE score and your walking speed increases by 15 ft. This replaces the reduction and movement bonus of your Mastered Trait. As a reaction for 1 CE, you gain a bonus to AC equal to thrice your CE modifier until the beginning of your next turn.

Elemental. The additional damage of your elemental cursed energy now equals your CE score and the penalties a creature suffers now last until the target finishes a long rest.

effects.name: Ultimate Cursed Energy Trait (toggle)
effects.description: Conditional bonus: enable this effect while its condition applies.
